technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish momentum with extreme overbought conditions and Ichimoku cross-up, but undermined by long-term downtrend, weak ADX, and elevated reversal risk from RSI extremes.

fundamental.summary: TRMB shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings 9 days away.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling by junior member in fear environment with no news data; insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (341), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event today, and earnings in 9 days create compounded risk for TRMB.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum with Ichimoku cross-up, RSI extreme overbought, supertrend bullish, and price above all short-term MAs creates tactical entry setup near support at 63.72.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, FOMC today, rising DXY), long-term downtrend below 200-EMAs, weak ADX conviction, high earnings risk in 9 days, and extreme RSI overbought at 85.74 create compounded reversal risk that outweighs short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support (63.72) with short-term Ichimoku cross-up and supertrend bullish, the setup is negated by extreme RSI overbought (85.74), long-term downtrend below 200-EMAs, and weak ADX conviction (23.81).
decision.primary_risk: Earnings in 9 days combined with VIX crisis (341), FOMC event today, and RSI extreme overbought create compounded reversal risk that could trigger sharp drawdown before earnings announcement.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding TRMB with 33 open IT positions (7.2% sector concentration); adding to existing position during macro crisis and earnings proximity violates risk discipline.
